images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: anime clothing-only design reference sheet, first of a two-sheet clothing set.
Primary request: 从文字重新设计一张黑白女仆装服饰设定图。只画服装本身，不画人物或人体，也不使用人台。
Style/medium: polished Japanese anime costume design sheet, precise fine clean line art, flat pastel color accents and restrained two-tone cel shading. Clearly hand-drawn 2D anime aesthetic, not realistic photography, not 3D or fabric simulation.
Scene/backdrop: clean pale warm gray paper, tidy restrained layout, ample margins.
Subject and exact garment design:
黑色连衣裙，方领、短泡泡袖，领口和袖口各一圈细白蕾丝；前襟一排小银色圆扣。裙摆及膝、轻盈微蓬，内衬一层薄纱支撑弧度，裙摆轮廓克制。
白色围裙，肩带和下摆有适量荷叶边，腰后系大蝴蝶结，围裙有实用口袋，口袋露出点单本和笔。白色蕾丝发箍，两个黑色发带蝴蝶结，胸前一枚小银色咖啡杯胸针。
奶白色 80D 哑光平纹连裤袜，宽软腰口、同色加固脚尖；另有白色棉质短袜，翻折袜口带窄扇形蕾丝边。黑色圆头低跟玛丽珍鞋，单横带配小银扣。
Composition: main large front view of dress with apron, smaller rear view showing apron bow, all displayed as empty garments with open neckline and no body inside; arrange separate opaque tights as a flat garment with visible waistband, pair of lace-cuff socks, shoes, headband, ribbons, brooch neatly beside it. Mildly sweet Japanese cafe uniform styling, visually refined and practical. Front/back views must depict exactly the same outfit.
Text: small clean heading “黑白女仆装”; short labels only if needed.
Constraints: clothing only. No people, no face, no head, no hair, no skin, no body silhouettes, no mannequin. No underwear on this sheet. No safety shorts. No cat ears, cat tails, extra accessories, extra jackets, logos or watermark. Keep full garments in frame.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: anime clothing-only design reference sheet, second of a two-sheet clothing set.
Primary request: 根据以下文字生成一张独立的日常内衣产品设定图，仅展示两件服装，文胸和内裤，不出现任何人物或人体。
Exact garment design:
文胸：暖米白色光面无钢圈文胸，平整薄杯，杯面用哑光细密面料；可调节肩带配小巧的磨砂银色调节扣，领边和下围以同色窄边收口，整体线条简洁。
内裤：同色中腰三角内裤，棉莫代尔面料，常规包覆剪裁；腰边平整，裤口用柔软的同色窄包边，侧缝细而整齐。
Style/medium: polished Japanese anime clothing design illustration, delicate precise linework, mostly flat warm ivory color and restrained two-tone cel shading; a clean 2D illustrated catalog/reference sheet, not photography, not realistic 3D rendering. Understated modern functional everyday basics, simple clean construction.
Scene/backdrop: pale warm gray paper matching a black-white maid uniform companion design sheet, tidy layout with generous margins.
Composition: flat-lay empty garments with no body within them. Bra front and back views in upper half, panties front and back views in lower half. Natural unfilled fabric form, clean readable shoulder straps, small matte silver strap adjusters, narrow matching bindings and seams. All views consistent. Small material and seam detail inset only if helpful.
Text: heading “日常内搭”; short labels “文胸” and “内裤”.
Constraints: neutral clothing product design only. No person, model, torso, limbs, skin, mannequin or body silhouette. Fabric opaque, ordinary coverage. No bows, frills, lace, animal/cartoon motifs, print patterns, jewelry, sheer fabric, exaggerated shaping or decorative cutouts. No safety shorts, hosiery, apron or outerwear. No extra clothing items. No logos or watermark.
